shared_elements: incised linear surface detail (hatching / repeated parallel strokes)
eye rendered as a raised/incised oval
justification: Both are low-to-medium relief on stone showing animals in strict profile with eyes marked as incised ovals and areas filled by repetitive incised strokes, which is the most specific correspondence. But A is a tall pillar divided into stacked registers of small, flat, schematic creatures rendered with sparse shallow lines, whereas B is a single monumental head filling the whole field, modelled in deeper relief with dense, virtuoso decorative curls, so the composition and level of craft are quite unlike.
